body:
NEXT VIZ DESIGN CHECKPOINT — proposed bead: Atlas feature scale parity with the Codex. No edits or reservation; sequence after gemini-3.7-flash's atlas hardening bead so atlas.scala has one owner.

1. One shared scale type, not parallel Codex/Atlas vocabularies. Promote CodexScale to view-level FeatureScale = SurfaceUnit(SurfaceUnitKind) | NarrativeUnit(NarrativeUnitBasis). Preserve source compatibility with a CodexScale alias/facade if worth it; CodexSpec and AtlasSpec consume the same canonicalString/label and exact target matcher. No Window target coercion.

2. AtlasSpec gains featureScale (default Sentence); NarrativeScene carries a typed AtlasFeatureLayer plan:
   - FeatureChannelState (NotRequested | Unresolved | Missing | SidecarRequired)
   - selected FeatureScale
   - deterministic FeatureObservationPlacement entries, each keyed by FeatureAddress.Observation(space,target), with the horizon-clipped exact SpanSet, per-span x extents (never a hull across discontinuities), and Space/Derivation audit addresses.
This plan is separate from VisualPrimitive: without numeric sidecar values there is no terrain mark to draw and no fake zero/placeholder geometry.

3. Factor the current Codex feature-selection machinery into one private[view] pure planner used by both compilers: checked FeatureSelection resolution; duplicate target/row rejection; exact scale filtering; one SupportResolver; EvidenceVisibility.clipSupport; state/count calculation. Codex alone maps placements into TextAnnotations/lane allocation. Atlas retains placements for the downstream materializer. This makes V-E3 and HorizonShared identical by construction rather than duplicated.

4. storymodel4s view does not decode sidecars and gains no codec dependency. The storyatlas4s resolver later joins the plan to codec.SidecarTrack, validates row/value/coverage/missingness, then lowers a materialized terrain/field through Intaglio. Missing and Unresolved remain explicit and never become zero. The current Laminar work stays with the chief; this bead makes no storyatlas4s edit.

5. Receipt/twin: bump Atlas configuration to a versioned canonical rendering that binds feature selection + featureScale (exact field order/escaping added to ADR 0002 D13); Atlas textual twin prints scale, selection, resolved space, channel state, and each planned observation/support. Feature selection changes do not move base regions/landmarks/threads/routes.

6. Laws/gate: exact token/sentence/clause/paragraph/situation/scene/episode/story filtering on WOG; clipped support equality at omniscient and ReaderAt, including a true mid-unit cut; discontinuous support stays discontinuous; duplicate refs fail closed; raw/legacy-derived/basis-unresolved states match Codex; input order deterministic; non-feature marks invariant under scale/feature changes; config changes with scale/basis; twin names the plan. view + fixtures JVM/JS/Native, compileAll, scalafmtCheckAll.

Likely paths after hardening lands: compiler.scala (shared planner/type extraction), atlas.scala, codex.scala only for shared-name migration/twin compatibility, AtlasSuite, CodexCompilerSuite, WOG Atlas/CodexCompiler suites, ADR 0002 D13. No features/core/codec edits.

Chief decisions requested before bead creation: (a) shared FeatureScale rename with CodexScale compatibility facade, or keep the misleading CodexScale name temporarily; (b) approve the non-rendered AtlasFeatureLayer plan as the portable sidecar-resolution seam, rather than adding a value-free VisualPrimitive.
